cases.name: messy everyday dictation
cases.tests: filler removal, punctuation, preserving casual phrasing
cases.raw: Um okay so I was looking at the thing yesterday and uh I think we should probably just leave it how it is for now because honestly I'm not really sure if changing it is gonna make anything better
cases.expected: Okay, so I was looking at the thing yesterday, and I think we should probably just leave it how it is for now because, honestly, I'm not really sure if changing it is gonna make anything better.

cases.name: changing a recipient mid-sentence
cases.tests: resolving a correction without removing the original recipient from a separate instruction
cases.raw: Hey can you send that over to Jake tomorrow no wait send it to Marcus tomorrow morning and uh make sure Jake is copied on it too
cases.expected: Hey, can you send that over to Marcus tomorrow morning and make sure Jake is copied on it too?

cases.name: numbers that must not be rewritten
cases.tests: numeric self-corrections while preserving the spoken representation of other numbers
cases.raw: Uh the price should be fifteen dollars no wait fifty dollars per month and the setup fee is still one hundred and twenty five dollars
cases.expected: The price should be fifty dollars per month, and the setup fee is still one hundred and twenty five dollars.

cases.name: uncertainty that must remain
cases.tests: not inventing certainty or rewriting the speaker's reasoning
cases.raw: Um I think the issue might be with the database but I'm not completely sure because it was working yesterday and uh I haven't checked the logs yet
cases.expected: I think the issue might be with the database, but I'm not completely sure because it was working yesterday, and I haven't checked the logs yet.

cases.name: multiple corrections in one sentence
cases.raw: So let's schedule it for Tuesday no wait Wednesday at two actually no wait Wednesday at three and uh make sure everyone gets the invite
cases.expected: So let's schedule it for Wednesday at three, and make sure everyone gets the invite.

cases.name: technical dictation
cases.tests: technical accuracy, preservation of negation, and avoiding unauthorized deletion of repeated words
cases.raw: Okay so uh when the request comes in check if the token is expired and if it is then return a 401 but don't automatically refresh it because we uh we haven't implemented that part yet
cases.expected: Okay, so when the request comes in, check if the token is expired, and if it is, then return a 401. But don't automatically refresh it because we we haven't implemented that part yet.

cases.name: spoken correction inside technical instructions
cases.tests: correcting one configuration value without modifying another
cases.raw: Set the timeout to thirty seconds no wait sixty seconds and uh keep the retry count at three because anything higher might cause issues
cases.expected: Set the timeout to sixty seconds and keep the retry count at three because anything higher might cause issues.

cases.name: casual message with unnecessary fillers
cases.tests: preserving personality, frustration, and the word like rather than overly formalizing the message
cases.raw: Dude um I genuinely don't understand why this keeps happening like every time I fix one thing something else breaks and uh it's actually getting pretty annoying
cases.expected: Dude, I genuinely don't understand why this keeps happening. Like, every time I fix one thing, something else breaks, and it's actually getting pretty annoying.

cases.name: important negative instruction
cases.tests: preserving both negative instructions and their rationale
cases.raw: Uh don't delete the old files after the migration finishes because we still need them for testing and um don't overwrite the backup either
cases.expected: Don't delete the old files after the migration finishes because we still need them for testing, and don't overwrite the backup either.

cases.name: a phrase that looks like a correction but isn't
cases.tests: recognizing that I mean is meaningful here, not a self-correction marker
cases.raw: I mean what I said yesterday and uh I don't want anyone changing the requirements without talking to me first
cases.expected: I mean what I said yesterday, and I don't want anyone changing the requirements without talking to me first.

cases.name: quoted filler word
cases.tests: preserving an um that is explicitly part of quoted content, while removing the unrelated filler
cases.raw: The recording literally starts with the words um I don't know and uh I want that exact quote included in the report
cases.expected: The recording literally starts with the words "um, I don't know," and I want that exact quote included in the report.

cases.name: long messy multi-condition thought
cases.tests: long-range coherence, explicit correction, dependency preservation, and informal wording
cases.raw: Okay so um I was thinking about the update and I think we should release it tomorrow no wait Friday because uh we still need to test the login stuff and I don't wanna push it out before that's done but if everything passes by Thursday then Friday should be fine
cases.expected: Okay, so I was thinking about the update, and I think we should release it Friday because we still need to test the login stuff, and I don't wanna push it out before that's done. But if everything passes by Thursday, then Friday should be fine.
